# Volume 2 timeline

## I An Irate Neighbor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Anne's peaceful afternoon reading [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) is interrupted by her angry neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who confronts her after her cow strays into his oats field. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the incident and family matters with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), after which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) arrives and shares local gossip about incoming residents.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Stephen Irving's son coming to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plans to form a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) cautions against, and the news that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) will be teaching at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)** — On their way back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discover a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impetuously sells the animal on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home, she discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes in horror that she has mistakenly sold Mr. Harrison's cow.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P28](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0028), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035)_

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to confess that she accidentally sold his cow, offering her own cow in exchange. Despite initial squabbling and insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) accepts her apology, trades cows, and invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share a cake and tea with him. They become friends, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to happily share the good outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053)_

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — On the eve of beginning their teaching jobs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate whether corporal punishment is ever necessary in school. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also scoffs at her ideal of governing pupils purely through affection. The next morning, a anxious [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before setting off to school.

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Morley, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and feeling a special connection with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an eccentric parent, Mrs. Donnell, confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about how her children's names are pronounced and used. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her experience with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), remaining determined to win over the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023)_

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive around canvassing their assigned road to raise money for painting the hall on behalf of the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They encounter various eccentric neighbors, including grim Miss Eliza, her optimistic sister Catherine, a stressed husband in an apron, and an overly neat Mrs. White.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their canvassing efforts, encountering a variety of colorful neighbors across [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon hearing that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a newborn son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) seizes the opportunity to secure a large five-dollar donation from the proud father. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute to the cause.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P57](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0057)_

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their teaching experiences and future ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses taking in the Keith twins due to their mother's failing health, which she ultimately agrees to do with Anne's encouragement.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P33](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0033)_

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At supper, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) acts rambunctiously and snatches Dora's cake, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to try teaching him gentlemanly manners. After supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed early in the west gable room while she takes [Dora](../character/dora.md) to sleep with her.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hurriedly removes the toad using a fire shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can discover it, then notices [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signaling from her window.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062)_

## IX A Question of Color

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), Improvers, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), Pyes, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After walking home through [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discover that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) claims not to know where she is. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and realizes [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lied about it. When confronted, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) tearfully promises never to tell another lie after learning it is wrong, though he later argues to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in bed that [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) also lied to him about prayers.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about how lying was the dreadful consequence of him stopping his prayers. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes downstairs and shares the story with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), leading to a conversation about Davy's behavior, schooling, and why they find themselves fond of him despite his mischief.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P75](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0075), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P81](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0081), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md)** — In a detailed letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her experiences and humorous anecdotes from teaching her pupils. She shares various amusing classroom incidents and transcripts of letters written by her students, concluding with a imaginative composition by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

**[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes a letter to his teacher detailing his vivid imaginary friends who live by the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailor.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md). At the end of the letter, he adds a postscript clarifying that the stories are not actually true.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046)_

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Suffering from a toothache and a frustrating day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly orders a pupil to throw a package into the school stove, causing an explosion of firecrackers. Later, when [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) plays a prank on her with a mouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) loses her temper and whips him. Though distraught over her loss of self-control, she discovers the next morning that the punishment earned Anthony's respect.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's forgotten overgrown garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) tells Hester's tragic and romantic story.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss the life and memory of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) while lingering in her garden. Afterwards, they explore the nearby woods and fields, enjoying a lunch by a brook where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) share poetic thoughts on nature and souls before returning home at sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about Marilla's improving eyesight and the upcoming [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar, then returns home to learn that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) will remain with them through the fall. She recalls disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for eating forbidden jam, after which she attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) alerts everyone to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) attempt to talk Judson out of it, but he refuses to change his mind.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) attempt to convince [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to paint advertisements on his fences, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose him, Judson agrees to drop the advertisement plan to secure her silence.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as they discuss family, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together chatting about ideals, teaching mistakes, studies with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and the true meaning of friendship.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)_

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is coming to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and she eagerly plans a elaborate dinner for the occasion. She spends the following days busy with preparations and keeping the children in line for the big event.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P28](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0028), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P35](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0035)_

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and cook a feast to entertain Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), but a series of mishaps occurs, including [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruining the lemon pies and accidentally knocking a heavy conch shell onto Miss Barry's borrowed platter. Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until a letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — After the guests leave and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss life's disappointments, how to resolve the broken platter, local gossip, and Anne's plan to take the twins on a shore picnic.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P67](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0067)_

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — After a conversation with [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets off with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to search for a replacement willow-ware platter. Their search leads them to the Copp house on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets stuck after crashing through the roof of a duckhouse while peering through the pantry window. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stays with her through a rainstorm until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns home, frees [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with an axe, and agrees to host tea and discuss selling her platter.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P60](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0060)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) for looking in her window, and [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea. [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) agrees to sell her willow-ware platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars, revealing she is saving money for her upcoming marriage. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) with the platter, laughing over their adventure.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P59](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0059), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), then visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea and reassures him about his imaginative nature. Upon returning home, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) say his prayers and mend his jealous feelings. Later, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting on how mature and handsome he has become.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P37](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) shares a bedtime story of his good deed with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before she walks to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to meet [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss the progress and upcoming initiatives of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as well as the return of their school teaching friends. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to discuss her busy plan of chores for the following day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md)** — School resumes, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Dora's first days and Mirabel Cotton's ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost on their way to a tea party and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they are invited to stay for tea by the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a charming tea party with Miss Lavendar and her young assistant, Charlotta the Fourth. After showing off her echoes in the garden and explaining Charlotta's name, Miss Lavendar becomes suddenly quiet and worn when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). The girls take their leave, promising to visit again soon.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss Lavendar, as well as the history of [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's family, while trying to manage Davy's poor table manners. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) so they can permanently stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, where they share tea, make candy, and discuss Miss Lavendar's past romance with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Miss Lavendar agrees to meet Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and a month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for a delightful visit.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029)_

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Observer](../character/observer.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)** — After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) publish a mock newspaper note about Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a severe severe hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact predicted day, causing massive devastation to crops, trees, and windows. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, later learning of the damage around town, including the death of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with him. The news quickly spreads through the neighborhood and school, leading Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to step in and assist [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) at his newly cleaned home, where he prepares to explain the backstory of his marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) originally separated over domestic habits and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) before reconciling. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays to eat tea with the Harrisons, walks back across the fields with [Emily](../character/emily.md), and later puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while conversing with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P56](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0056), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about college, future romantic ideals, and local gossip regarding [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md). The two friends reaffirm their deep and lasting friendship as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to head to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P44](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0044), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)_

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chatted with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), school pranks, and marriage until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughed herself out to the cellar hatch. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walked to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth, enjoying lunch, playing with echoes, and gathering wild strawberries.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P35](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0035)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — While berry picking, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her worries over Miss Lavendar's melancholy mood and changed behavior. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during her vacation to help cheer Miss Lavendar up. Later, while having tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss Lavendar about her imaginary dream-boy before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059)_

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Stephen asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to inquire if he may visit Miss Lavendar, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message and help Miss Lavendar prepare for his arrival.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him at the door and ushers him inside to meet Miss Lavendar. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch from the window and celebrate when they see Stephen and Miss Lavendar walking together affectionately in the garden.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
